description: Stock items: create a catalog item, record a movement on the append-only log (SOLD/RECEIVED/ADJUSTED/PRODUCED), or read counts. Capacity items (rooms, seats, bays) are reserve's.

op.description: create_item | move (a stock movement; books SOLD/RECEIVED) | get (one item by item_id, or all).

item_id.description: move: required. get: filter. create_item: optional slug, stored as <location>#<slug|uuid>.

unit_cost.description: create_item, required: cost per unit (COGS on SOLD, AP on RECEIVED).

unit_price.description: create_item: sell price; omit for ingredients.

revenue_account.description: create_item: sales account; omit for the catalog rule (goods SALES_REVENUE, services SERVICE_REVENUE).

availability_rule.description: create_item: RRULE making this a capacity item (FREQ=DAILY); booked with reserve.

availability_duration.description: create_item: seconds per occurrence (86400 a night); required with availability_rule.

components.description: create_item: recipe, component item_id -> quantity per unit; PRODUCED assembles from it.

vendors.description: create_item: contact_ids bought from, preferred first.

quantity.description: move, required: positive for SOLD/RECEIVED/PRODUCED; signed for ADJUSTED (negative = short), valued at unit_cost.

movement_type.description: move, required: SOLD (dr COGS/cr INVENTORY) | RECEIVED (dr INVENTORY/cr AP) | ADJUSTED | PRODUCED (no entry).

source.description: move: '<namespace>:<id>' — job:<invoice_id>, po:<po_id>, produce:<item_id>, subject:<contact_id>. Never free text.

on_order.description: move: units already on an open PO; the reorder read skips them.
